purpose: Why can a slanted storage frame keep the same volume?

definition.formal_latex: \vec u=(a,0,0),\quad\vec v=(s,b,0),\quad\vec w=(1,0.5,h),\quad T=\vec u\cdot(\vec v\times\vec w)=a b h,\quad V=|T|.
